value.claim: Democrats outnumber Republicans 3.87 million to 3.63 million; D +55,400 since January, R -7,400
value.evidence: Level is right: DOS file 10/19 shows D 3,879,531 R 3,638,448 [V]. Omitted: the D edge (241,083) is smaller than at the 2024 election (286,283), 2022 (549,568), 2020 (685,818), 2018 (840,443) and 2016 (916,274) [V/M]. "Growing" holds only for the post-2025 window.

rows.note: The verdict is our like-for-like reading of the claim (grade I); the evidence cites its own grades.

value.headline: Pennsylvania voter registration: Democrats expand advantage for the first time in years
value.claim: D lead grew from 170,608 (Oct 2025) to 188,381; still far behind the 281,091 edge before the 2024 election
value.evidence: The article itself states the 2024 comparison. By 10/19/2026 the edge is 241,083 [V], still below Nov 2024 (286,283 in the official 2024 file) [V].
